caption: The drawing contains two main objects, both rendered in fine pencil lines with light blue accents. At the top center, there is a circular plate or dish depicted from a top-down view. The outer edge of the plate has a scalloped pattern, and the border is decorated with symmetrical swirling motifs and small circular blue dots evenly spaced throughout. Inside the border, the flat surface of the dish has a circular center field with a grid or lattice pattern. Below this, a side view of the same plate or dish is shown, revealing its shallow depth and elaborately decorated rim with scrolling patterns similar to those seen on the top. Both objects appear centered within a lightly outlined rectangular frame on a cream-colored background. The drawing is signed "MARIE FANELARD" at the bottom right, with additional small, faint notations beneath the rectangle.
title: Sandwich Glass
